competency.campaign.title: Campaigns
competency.campaign.intro: A campaign runs over a span of days, such as the plate exchange or the bolo season. Each office has a target set by the unit above it, and its daily count is shown against that target. A plate counts on the day the old plate gave way to the national one; a bolo counts on the day of its inspection, unless it is void.

competency.ownershipTransfers.title: Ownership transfers
competency.ownershipTransfers.intro: Change of a vehicle's owner (name transfer). The sellers come from the register and the request names the buyers. The vehicle is checked against its paper inspection and a committee sets its value. Letters go to the justice office, the revenue office and, for a code-3 vehicle, the tax office. Once the fee is paid and the approver agrees, the owners change in the register and a new libre is issued. The system never works out a tax or a duty.
